recipes.name: Cindy's Tuna, Spinach, and Bacon Quiche
ingredients_raw: 1 (12 ounce) can solid white tuna packed in water, drained
3 slices bacon strips, cooked and chopped

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Whisk together eggs, milk, blue cheese dressing, and cornstarch in a bowl until smooth. Fold in spinach, tuna, bacon, and Swiss cheese until evenly mixed. Pour into pie shell.
Bake in preheated oven until a knife inserted into the center comes out clean, 30 to 35 minutes.

review.reviewBody: This is a WONDERFUL base recipe, and so versatile. I make it (for myself, for lunch) at least once a week. I bake it "crustless" in a pyrex pie plate (which I "grease" with Olive Oil) because I don't particularly care for "prepared" pie crusts. I like it with Blue Cheese Dressing, but Ranch works nicely, too. I LOVE the Tuna/Spinach/Bacon mix, but (pre-cooked) boneless chicken breast (instead of tuna) works well, too. I LOVE Swiss chees, but sometimes I use Provolone, Velveeta or Pepperjack. Sometimes I include chopped onions, scallions, fresh mushrooms and/or bell peppers. One "pie" lasts me 2 or 3 days. Sometimes I make toast, sometimes I have Saltine or Ritz Crackers with it. Regardless, it's ALWAYS good.

I really liked this recipe; great new application for tuna. I did use fresh spinach as opposed to frozen because it is what I had on hand, but I don't think that changed the integrity of the recipe. I do agree with another reviewer that there was not enough egg to make it have the true mouth feel of a quiche. So next time I will add two more eggs and skip the cornstarch. Thanks Ms. Kitti for posting this recipe!

Newbie at AllRecipes so I took a pic after I cut it thinking it wouldn't post. WRONG! Great recipe... start. I sauteed mushrooms, garlic, onions with the spinach and bacon! I was afraid to add the tuna and dressing at that point so I basically have a spinach, bacon and swiss cheese quiche. I also added a small mixture of mixed cheddar cheeses at the bottom. Like others, I reduced the milk. I browned the pie crust for 10 minutes only because my hubby likes it that way. I really like it and I look forward to trying this again over the holidays! I rate it a 4 but I'm sure an upgrade is coming soon!
